mapper.sql: e.id, e.name, e.phone_number, e.nick_name, e.avatar, e.last_login_time, e.last_login_ip, er.role_Id
mapper.select: select , p.permission_code from employee e inner join employee_role er on e.id=er.employee_id and er.employee_Id = #{employeeId} and e.is_deleted=0 and er.is_deleted=0 inner join role_permission rp on er.role_id=rp.role_id and rp.is_deleted=0 inner join permission p on p.id=rp.permission_id and p.is_deleted=0 order by e.create_time

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_alias FROM employee_role er INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON er.role_id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE er.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND er.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.permission_alias IS NOT NULL AND p.permission_alias != ''
